purpose: Fresh end-to-end prompts on v1.10: natural prompt compilation and ordinary composition, without post-composition sound swaps. Constraint checks are not musical-quality scores. Vague prompts have no single required genre.

cases.prompt: A breezy soundtrack for cooking lunch with friends while sunlight fills the kitchen. Instrumental, 32 bars.
cases.listenFor: Relaxed social energy, warmth and a groove that stays in the background.

cases.prompt: Music for the last train home: tired but hopeful, with a steady sense of motion. Instrumental, 32 bars.
cases.listenFor: Reflective mood with forward movement; judge the inferred style rather than enforcing one genre.

cases.prompt: A small room at dawn: quiet, spacious music that leaves room to think. Instrumental, 32 bars.
cases.listenFor: Restraint, space and low distraction; avoid treating a correct label as proof of mood.

cases.prompt: Restless, playful music for walking quickly through a crowded market. Instrumental, 32 bars.
cases.listenFor: Playful momentum and rhythmic interest without arbitrary density or constant identical stabs.

cases.prompt: Liquid drum and bass in D minor at 174bpm, 32 bars, with deep sub bass, celesta harmony and an alto flute melody, repeating broken chords. Instrumental.
cases.listenFor: Recognizable liquid D&B movement, celesta/alto-flute separation, smooth sub and reusable motifs.

cases.prompt: Country instrumental in G major at 104bpm, 32 bars in 6/8, with resonator guitar, upright bass and a harmonica lead, strummed chords.
cases.listenFor: Compound-meter country pulse, resonator character and phrasing that fits 6/8.

cases.prompt: Chamber classical in C major at 76bpm, 32 bars in 3/4, with harpsichord harmony and recorder melody, broken chords, just intonation with A4=432Hz. Instrumental.
cases.listenFor: Clear triple meter, chamber balance, pitched harpsichord/recorder and coherent melodic phrases.

cases.prompt: Electro in F minor at 116bpm, 32 bars, with additive synth harmony, FM synth lead and electric bass, chord riff, markov melody, phrase cadences, max leap 5. Instrumental.
cases.listenFor: Electro identity, additive/FM contrast, a coherent constrained lead and a groove beyond repeated three-stab patterns.

cases.prompt: Bright house in A major at 126bpm, 32 bars, warm sustained bass and soft pad chords, no piano, no lead, no arpeggios. Instrumental.
cases.listenFor: House pulse with warm held bass and pads; the exclusions must affect the actual voices.

cases.prompt: UK garage in F minor at 134bpm, 32 bars, bass strictly between the kicks, sparse offbeat organ chords, no lead or arpeggios. Instrumental.
cases.listenFor: Skipping garage groove and audible bass/drum interplay while kick/bass grid clashes remain absent.

cases.prompt: Industrial bass in B minor at 100bpm, 32 bars, sustained metallic bass throughout, dark synth pads, no piano or acoustic guitar. Instrumental.
cases.listenFor: Intentionally metallic continuous bass: ensure preference feedback has not suppressed an explicit metallic request.

cases.prompt: A sparse drum-only footwork beat at 160bpm, 32 bars; no bass, no chords, no lead and no arpeggios.
cases.listenFor: Footwork identity and variation carried by drums alone; exclusions should not produce a silent track.
